Sintel

2010 · Animation · 52 min · Blender Foundation
Fantasy Adventure 1080p

A lonely young woman, Sintel, helps and befriends a dragon whom she calls Scales. When Scales is kidnapped by an adult dragon, Sintel decides to embark on a dangerous quest to find her lost friend.
